purpose: Independent read-only validator V5 full-only contract for the completed V4 candidate five-route 10385-point full grid. It preserves validator V1/V2/V3/V4, all predecessor audits, the formal full-run gate and authorization, and candidate outputs; it authorizes only full postcheck with an explicit CLI flag and requires two deterministic validator runs before final acceptance.
path_base: parent directory of this contract's code directory

V2-REP-001.rule: JSON null/empty CSV and HDF5 NaN are equivalent only for explicitly nullable numeric point fields.

operational_manifest_review.comparison_rule: Normalize only audit.add human-description text; require the complete remaining executable AST to equal sealed validator V3 exactly.

hard_fail: rho abs difference to Step-4 greater than 1e-8
independently recomputed gated polynomial or Laurent SVD residual nonfinite or greater than 1e-8
formula identity relative difference greater than 1e-12
information_only: compact/full-q rho and all-root distance diagnostics
origin multiplicity splitting when every unmatched-root safety gate passes

postcheck_activation_requires: root full authorization SHA-256 and attestation fields match
four formal full-run gate file SHA-256 values match
candidate contract/script/input seal SHA-256 values match
complete validator V4 pilot-postcheck chain remains unchanged and PASS
sealed full artifact manifest/run status/run metadata SHA-256 values match
fresh explicit external CLI authorization flag
two deterministic V5 full-postcheck executions before final acceptance

mode_policy.precheck: Authorized. It hashes the authorization/gate/candidate/V4 chain and verifies full manifest, run status and checkpoints without executing the 10385-point independent SVD loop.
mode_policy.pilot-postcheck: Hard-locked. Validator V5 full-only rejects pilot mode before candidate scientific output is parsed.
mode_policy.full-postcheck: Sealed for the completed five-route 10385-point full grid and requires the explicit CLI authorization flag.
